identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][defect] Keep deferred-validator admission consistent across ready transition

values.task_boundary: One lifecycle-readiness consistency defect across initialized, ready, and bound phases; no broad lifecycle redesign.
deliverables: Focused #79 positive and negative regression proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Doctor never recommends an operation that strands an unchanged currently passing packet.
AC-2: An exact #79 deferred-target packet has a typed path through initialized and ready to bind without placeholders.
AC-3: The unchanged packet remains bindable after typed advance_ready, or an explicitly supported lossless recovery exists.
AC-4: Exact issue-owned paths, non-placeholder reasons, proving lanes, and fail-closed policy remain mandatory; invalid deferrals block.
AC-5: Bound and later phases reject missing validators, zero selected tests, and absent proof.
AC-6: A regression follows initialized doctor PASS, advance_ready, ready doctor/bind, bound failure, and materialized-target PASS.
AC-7: Existing #79 positive/negative tests, focused C-SDLC v2 tests, formatting, and strict Clippy pass.
AC-8: Fresh exact-head review confirms lifecycle consistency and no widening of pre-bind implementation authority.
dependencies: Closed #79 deferred-target contract as regression baseline
Open #342 reproduction is read-only evidence only
